message: You know that moment when you realize you've become the gloriously over-prepared person? 🤔 I found myself packing my kids' go-bags with everything from snacks to extra socks, and suddenly I was the mom with a mini survival kit in the trunk! While my friends laughed, I felt a little more at ease knowing we were ready for anything. It’s a bit of work, but having those bags ready brings me peace of mind. What’s your favorite tip for being prepared without going overboard?
